text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: Peregrine Financial (tenant: peregrine-prod) — sustained model latency spike in dedicated-vpc us-west-2. 95th pct latency > 2.5s, error rate up ~4%. Severity: SEV-2. Paging oncall. Link: <https://redwood.internal/alerts/3532109876|alert>

amber_oncall: I’m on it. seeing the same in dashboards. Routing errors to safevariant increased, some 429s from the pool.

jay_sre: joining. can you post the exact error signature? stack traces or recent logs?

amber_oncall: quick log tail:
```
2026-03-15T05:11:02Z peregrine-prod text-gen-3b inst=dedicated-3 err=kv-cache-miss latency=2580ms status=200
2026-03-15T05:11:43Z peregrine-prod text-gen-3b inst=dedicated-3 err=backend-queue-timeout latency=3120ms status=504
2026-03-15T05:12:10Z peregrine-prod text-gen-3b inst=dedicated-2 err=eviction latency=4001ms status=500
```

leah_runtime: looks like KV cache evictions + queue backlog on dedicated-3. Could be a GC/oom on that node or kernel scheduling. Chris, any infra noisy neighbor alerts on that cluster?

chris_infra: checking. I see a scheduled maintenance job for an adjacent pool that started at 05:08, and a spike in GPU memory pressure on dedicated-3 host. Not marked unhealthy yet. No node reboots.

raul_solutions: Customer is seeing production API 95th latency affecting paymentflows (sync calls). Maya, heads up for account team.

maya_acctexec: ACK. I'm alerting Peregrine support now and asking for impact window. Tom, can you take the customer message after we decide mitigation?

tom_customerliaison: ready. prefer to give them a concise mitigation note and ETA. will stand by.

jay_sre: short term mitigation options:
- reroute peregrine-prod requests off dedicated-3 to other hosts in pool
- pin tenant to safevariant model with smaller KV footprint: text-gen-3b-safe-qt
- temporarily reduce max_seq_length via route override to lower memory pressure

amber_oncall: I can push a route override to reduce seq_length to 512 for peregrine-prod. That should reduce cache pressure. Want to do that while we evaluate pin.

leah_runtime: pinning to safevariant is preferable if it keeps output quality acceptable. Suggested command to pin:
```
redwoodctl tenant override set --tenant peregrine-prod --route default \
  --model text-gen-3b-safe-qt --comment "emergency safevariant pin during latency spike"
```

jay_sre: I'll prepare the routing change. Amber, can you do the override? I’ll monitor metrics.

amber_oncall: applying override now.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Action logged: route override applied by amber_oncall at 2026-03-15T05:15:07Z. Details: model=text-gen-3b-safe-qt, seq_limit=512. Audit: <https://redwood.internal/audit/3532109876|audit>

jay_sre: metrics update: 1m after override p95 dropped from 2.6s -> 1.1s, error rate to 0.9%. Good.

chris_infra: I’m isolating dedicated-3 host and draining new requests. Will run memcheck and restart inference worker if needed. If node recovers, we can rebalance.

raul_solutions: Customer update draft:
"We identified a performance regression affecting requests routed to one compute host in your dedicated pool. We’ve temporarily pinned your traffic to a lower-footprint model variant and applied a request-size limit to restore latency. Engineers are continuing remediation; we expect normal service in ~30–60 minutes. Contact: tom@redwood.com"

maya_acctexec: send that, please include that we’ll follow up with postmortem and if they need a rollback path to their previous model pinned, we have that option.

tom_customerliaison: sending now. will copy eng on reply.

amber_oncall: infra reports worker restart on dedicated-3 at 05:22. memory pressure cleared. Still seeing small queue backlog in logs but much improved.

leah_runtime: while we have safevariant pinned, we should schedule a canary pin back to original model on a subset of requests to validate. Suggest policy: 10% traffic to text-gen-3b (original) with fallback to safevariant on latency > 1.5s.

jay_sre: I’ll create a canary rollout via the console: route split 10/90 with timeout-based fallback. Command:
```
redwoodctl rollout create --tenant peregrine-prod --route default \
  --variants text-gen-3b:10,text-gen-3b-safe-qt:90 --fallback-policy timeout:1500ms
```

jay_sre: rollout created at 05:28.

incident-bot: :information_source: Monitoring rule: if p95 > 1.5s or error rate > 2% for peregrine-prod for 2 consecutive 1m windows, auto-rollback to safevariant and escalate to SEV-1.

amber_oncall: handing off to jay for the next 45m. Jay, you have the pager.

jay_sre: taking it. I'll keep monitoring and update every 15 minutes or on changes.

maya_acctexec: thanks team. I want a post-incident action item for a) longer-term retention of per-tenant eviction metrics, b) membership-based capacity reservations for peregrine (they're high-sensitivity), c) test scenario for mem-pressure during maintenance windows.

leah_runtime: noted. I’ll add model compaction/quantization options to product backlog for this tenant and propose a preemptive pinned safevariant policy for critical customers.

tom_customerliaison: Peregrine replied: "Thanks — latency improved after your change. We saw a few degraded responses, but critical flows passed. Please send timeline and fix details." I told them we’ll follow up with a detailed postmortem.

jay_sre: status @ 05:45: canary steady, p95 ~1.05s, error ~0.6%. dedicated-3 still in drained state. No further action needed unless metrics regress.

amber_oncall: leaving note: if dedicated-3 re-enters pool, ensure gradual reweighting, no sudden shift. Rebalance script: `infra rebalance --tenant peregrine-prod --max-inflight 50`.

chris_infra: I’ll schedule host health check and will only mark it back once memtest + worker cycles pass. ETA ~25m.

jay_sre: thanks. I’ll file an incident ticket and set assignees: leah_runtime (root cause analysis), chris_infra (node remediation), and leah_runtime+raul_solutions for customer follow-up. Ticket: <https://redwood.internal/incidents/3532109876|incident>

maya_acctexec: appreciate fast response. please cc me on postmortem.

jay_sre: will do. handing off final pager to the oncall rotation in 30m.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident thread acknowledged. If anyone needs to reopen paging escalate with `/pager reopen 3532109876`.
